note: Source of truth for the midnight-common-errors skill and the midskills-mcp lookup_error tool. Every row is lifted from a skill or reference in this repo; `skill` points at where the fix is explained. Edit here, then run `npm run sync:registry` to regenerate the SKILL.md tables. Never add a row you have not seen fail.

layers.title: Node rejections (`1010: Invalid Transaction: Custom error: N`)
Midnight.js, ZK artifacts, and private state

errors.cause: The wallet paying the fee had not synced every DUST event before building the fee offer
errors.fix: Wait for the paying wallet to sync, add the DUST fee offer again, then submit

errors.cause: DUST registration attempted before enough DUST was generated
errors.fix: Wait for generation before registering (`waitForGeneratedDust` in the Wallet SDK)

errors.cause: A stale wallet view reused DUST that was already spent
errors.fix: Resync the wallet and rebuild the transaction; do not run suites that share one wallet in parallel

errors.cause: The paying wallet's DUST does not cover fee plus overhead
errors.fix: Confirm the wait-for-DUST step succeeded; DUST accrues over time, it does not appear at once

errors.cause: Wallet not funded or not registered for DUST generation
errors.fix: Fund with (t)NIGHT and register it for DUST generation

errors.match: potential witness-value disclosure must be declared
errors.cause: A witness-derived value reaches a ledger write, a return, or another public sink without `disclose()`
errors.fix: Wrap the value in `disclose()` at the point it becomes public, and only if making it public is intended

errors.cause: Syntax the pinned language version does not accept, often code written for another version
errors.fix: Check `pragma language_version` against the toolchain in `midnight-version-matrix`; rewrite the construct

errors.cause: Unknown name: typo, missing `import CompactStandardLibrary;`, or a stdlib function that does not exist
errors.fix: Check the spelling and imports; confirm the function exists in the stdlib for your language version

errors.cause: `return` is not allowed inside a `for` body
errors.fix: Accumulate into a variable (or `fold`) and return after the loop

errors.cause: Circuits and structs cannot refer to themselves
errors.fix: Unroll into a bounded loop, or restructure the data

errors.cause: A circuit writes to a `sealed` ledger field (only the constructor may)
errors.fix: Set the field in the constructor, or drop `sealed`

errors.cause: `Counter` fields cannot be assigned
errors.fix: Do not initialise it in the constructor; use `.increment(n)` / `.decrement(n)`

errors.cause: Integer too narrow for Unix seconds
errors.fix: Use `Uint<64>` for all Unix times

errors.cause: That toolchain version is not installed
errors.fix: `compact update <version>` (see `midnight-version-matrix`), or drop the `+X`

errors.match: Version mismatch: compiled code expects X, runtime is Y
errors.cause: Contract compiled by one toolchain, `@midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime` from another
errors.fix: Pin the runtime from `midnight-version-matrix` and recompile with the matching `compact compile +<toolchain>`

errors.cause: Narrowing cast of a value that does not fit
errors.fix: Check bounds with `assert` before casting, or widen the type

errors.cause: `Counter` decremented below zero
errors.fix: Guard with `assert` on the current value first

errors.cause: `map.lookup(k).lookup(k2)` before the inner value was inserted
errors.fix: Insert the inner ADT first, or check membership before the lookup

errors.cause: Insert into a tree that `isFull()`
errors.fix: Pick a larger depth up front; check `isFull()` before inserting

errors.cause: Two copies of a WASM package (mixed `@midnight-ntwrk` / `@midnightntwrk` scopes, or duplicate runtimes), or the read object was passed instead of the decoded state
errors.fix: One copy per package (`npm ls`); decode with `read.contractState.deserialize({ v9: ContractState }).data`

errors.cause: Two different `compact-runtime` copies loaded (root and `contract/`)
errors.fix: `npm ls @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime`; make both resolve one version, or delete `contract/node_modules`

errors.match: ProtocolVersionMismatchError / Transaction decode / mainnet rejects tx
errors.cause: Built with `ledger-v8`, Midnight.js 4, or Wallet SDK 1.x against a Ledger 9 network
errors.fix: Move the whole project to the Ledger 9 set in `midnight-version-matrix`

errors.cause: ZK asset sync copied only `keys/` and `zkir/`
errors.fix: Also serve `compiler/` (`contract-manifest.json`, `contract-info.json`) next to them

errors.cause: Served artifacts do not match the manifest (partial or stale sync)
errors.fix: Re-run the asset sync after every recompile; serve all three dirs from one build

errors.match: queryContractState(...).data is undefined / ledger() fails on the result
errors.cause: Midnight.js 5 returns era-tagged bytes, not a `ContractState`
errors.fix: `ledger(read.contractState.deserialize({ v9: ContractState }).data)`

errors.match: setNetworkId is not a function / midnight-js-network-id not found
errors.cause: Removed in Midnight.js 5
errors.fix: Pass `networkId` in `providers.config` and the wallet configuration

errors.match: setContractAddress is not a function / private state lost
errors.cause: `PrivateStateProvider` is `forContract(address)`-scoped in 5.x
errors.fix: Use `levelPrivateStateProvider({ accountId, privateStoragePasswordProvider })`

errors.cause: Private-storage password too weak
errors.fix: At least 16 characters, 3 character classes, no long repeats or sequences

errors.match: CompiledContract is not exported / withVacantWitnesses type error
errors.cause: Imported from `compact-runtime`
errors.fix: Import `CompiledContract` from `@midnight-ntwrk/compact-js`

errors.match: 'bytes' does not exist in type Uint8Array
errors.cause: `Bytes<32>` parameters are plain `Uint8Array`; only `UserAddress` / `ZswapCoinPublicKey` structs are `{ bytes }`
errors.fix: Check the generated `contract/index.d.ts` for each parameter's shape

errors.cause: A Bech32m address string was parsed as hex or bytes
errors.fix: Decode with `wallet-sdk-address-format` and pass `{ bytes: Uint8Array }` to circuits

errors.match: Coin public key is all zeros
errors.cause: The connector returns Bech32m keys; an old helper only parsed hex
errors.fix: `ShieldedCoinPublicKey.codec.decode(networkId, MidnightBech32m.parse(key)).data`

errors.match: bigint type mismatch on constructor / circuit args
errors.cause: Passed `number` where the generated types want `bigint`
errors.fix: Wrap with `BigInt(value)` for every `Uint<N>` / `Field` argument

errors.cause: Wallet SDK 1.x signing bug
errors.fix: Upgrade to Wallet SDK 2.x; do not patch

errors.cause: Old `new WalletFacade()` usage or wrong package
errors.fix: Use the `WalletFacade.init()` static factory from the pinned `wallet-sdk-facade`

errors.cause: No extension installed, or the page read it before async injection
errors.fix: Poll for a few seconds; then ask the user to install a Midnight wallet

errors.cause: Several Midnight extensions installed
errors.fix: Let the user choose from `Object.values(window.midnight)`; never hardcode one key

errors.cause: The wallet cannot fetch ZK material from the dApp
errors.fix: Serve `compiler/`, `keys/`, and `zkir/` from the dApp

errors.cause: The DApp Connector takes no TTL
errors.fix: Expected: the wallet picks the expiry

errors.cause: Passkey domain changed
errors.fix: Delete the credential in the password manager and create it again

errors.cause: Old `indexer.preprod/mainnet.midnight.network` hosts (retired 9 Oct 2026)
errors.fix: Preprod/mainnet indexer and RPC are Blockfrost (`?project_id=<token>`); in browsers use the wallet's endpoints

errors.cause: No token, or a token for the other network
errors.fix: Use the per-network token with `networks.preprod(token)` / `networks.mainnet(token)`

errors.cause: Old indexer path
errors.fix: Local and preview indexers are `/api/v4/graphql` (WS `/api/v4/graphql/ws`)

errors.match: Contract subscription only sees new actions
errors.cause: No offset passed to a custom subscription
errors.fix: Pass `{ blockHeight: 0 }` to replay from the start

errors.match: Contract or balance missing on Preview
errors.cause: Preview relaunched as a new chain on 7 Nov 2026
errors.fix: Redeploy, re-request tNIGHT, re-register DUST

errors.cause: Method not exposed on this node
errors.fix: Call `rpc_methods`; fall back to the official Midnight RPC

errors.cause: The Compact binary is not on PATH
errors.fix: Open a new shell or source the installer's env file, then check `compact --version`

errors.cause: Proof server not running
errors.fix: Start the pinned `midnightntwrk/proof-server` image on port 6300

errors.cause: Another container holds the port
errors.fix: Stop it, or map another host port (`-p 6301:6300`) and point the proof provider there

errors.cause: A version that is not in the tested set
errors.fix: Install the pins from `midnight-version-matrix`; never fall back to `@latest`

errors.cause: Local devnet containers not healthy
errors.fix: Wait until node, indexer, and proof server are all healthy before running tests

errors.match: No native build was found ... classic-level (next build)
errors.cause: Server render evaluates wallet/SDK modules
errors.fix: Load the client component with `dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false })`

errors.cause: Browser bundle builds a filesystem path with `node:path`
errors.fix: Use a plain string for `withCompiledFileAssets` in browser code

errors.cause: Missing webpack experiments
errors.fix: Enable `asyncWebAssembly` and `topLevelAwait` in `next.config.mjs`

errors.cause: Node tried to import a directory
errors.fix: Import the file (or `dist/index.js`) explicitly; clear caches
